articles.summary: "Bye Sweet Carole" blends classic animation with horror in what creator Chris Darill says "might be one of the most complicated games to animate of in history." Discover how Little Sewing Machine and Dreams Uncorporated creatively solved animation challenges in Unity to create a visually stunning and responsive gameplay experience at 60 fps.
articles.title: Balancing animation fluidity with player inputs in Bye Sweet Carole

articles.title: Tailoring digital play by age: How StoryToys built the LEGO® Bluey app

articles.summary: Playables are one of the most effective ways to engage users. Emmanuel Bergman, Senior Manager and Graphic Designer at Unity's Ad Design Studio, dives into the best practices Studio uses to drive results for Unity partners.
articles.title: The power of play: Unlocking growth with playables
